Team/division description:
 

You will be working for the Human Resources division, called People & Innovation. You will be part of the Data Analytics and HR Solutions team (part of Business Innovation). Our main purpose is to ensure HR data is accurate, governed, business-relevant, and transformed into trusted analytics and reporting solutions by acting as the primary bridge between HR business stakeholders, IT data teams, and reporting developers.
 

We strive to deliver effective solutions towards business leaders and our Pan-E regional HR counterparts. Listening to the customer is essential to developing adequate and efficient solutions.
 

Your responsibilities
 

Your role is to support building foundation and contribute to strong employee experiences.
 

 
• HR Data Governance & Data Quality
 
• Business Analysis within HR Data Domain
 
• Bridge between HR and ITD Data Product Delivery Team
 
• Overview Snowflake operations (catalogue, ingest, semantic modelling design)
 
• Managing Power BI Reporting Portfolio (prioritisation and budget control)
 
• Stakeholder Management (withing HR areas and business)
 
• Monitoring testing and release management
 
• Ensure compliance, privacy & security rules are followed 

Your profile:
 

 
• English (Professional/Business Fluency), other languages are also an asset.
 
• Experience with Snowflake, Collibra and Data Product creation is essential for this role
 
• Knowledge of SQL, Qlick, Power BI is an asset
 
• Stakeholder Management
 
• Able to work with HR executives, HR operations teams, Data engineers, Solution architects, BI developers, Vendors
 
• Strong ability to simplify complex concepts, create executive summaries, present risks and recommendations.
 
• Our ideal candidate can facilitate workshops, and liaise with multinational teams
 
• The ideal candidate has a natural interest in the customer voice. They have proven similar past experiences, in the field of data governance, analytics, AI solutions design.
 
• Must be able to challenge assumptions, connect data across systems, identify root causes, spot inconsistencies.

Our client is a well-established company operating within an international environment. Known for its customer-focused approach and operational excellence, the company is looking to strengthen its Supply Chain department with a motivated and detail-oriented Purchasing & Supply Chain Officer.

This role offers the opportunity to work closely with suppliers, sales teams, and supply chain professionals while contributing to the smooth flow of daily operations.

Jobomschrijving

As a Purchasing & Supply Chain Officer, you will provide key administrative support to the purchasing and supply chain teams and help ensure an efficient and reliable supply process.

Your responsibilities include:

• Processing and monitoring purchase orders and supplier information
• Following up on delivery schedules and supplier commitments
• Ensuring accurate data management within the ERP system
• Identifying and reporting supply-related issues or discrepancies
• Supporting Supply Chain Planners with backorders and ongoing deliveries
• Assisting the sales team with product availability and lead-time inquiries
• Maintaining smooth communication between suppliers and internal departments
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of supply chain processes

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience
• Initial experience in purchasing, supply chain, logistics administration or a similar role
• Fluent in Dutch with a good professional knowledge of French and English
• Experience working with ERP systems
• Good Excel skills
• Strong organizational and administrative abilities
• Accurate, structured and detail-oriented
• Proactive and solution-driven mindset
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
 

Within the EHS team, the Safety Advisor is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and reports directly to the EHS Manager. The Safety Advisor works with fellow safety advisors to help create a safe and healthy ELC for teammates and external partners. This role collaborates closely with departments across the business, especially the Distribution Directors of the Distribution Centers (DCs) in Ham or Laakdal. The Safety Advisor also partners with DC teams and CPBW members to support continuous improvement in safety and health.
 

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
 

You will help protect the well-being of teammates and external partners by advising the employer and managers on safety and health. You will assess workstations and distribution activities, map risks, investigate hazards where needed, and translate findings into practical advice.
 

You will support new installations and processes by providing managers with commissioning reports that are clear, timely, and actionable.
 

You will strengthen prevention by supporting incident and accident investigations, identifying root causes, and proposing measures that help prevent recurrence.
 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 

Within the Nike ELC, Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) is looking for a Safety Advisor. This role is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and supports the employer in creating safe, healthy working conditions for teammates and external partners, in line with Belgian Welfare Legislation.
 

 
 

Your Baseline to Play at Pro Level:
 
 

•  

Safety Expertise. Level 1 certification preferred, or at least three years of hands-on experience at Level 2.
  

•  

Belgian Welfare Legislation Knowledge. Knowledge of, or experience with, Belgian welfare and workplace safety legislation.
  

•  

Collaboration Skills. Ability to work effectively with operational teams, managers, CPBW members, and stakeholders across the business.
  

•  

Independent Working Style. Able to work independently, manage priorities, and connect the right partners when follow-up is needed.
  

•  

Language Proficiency. Fluent in Dutch and English, with clear written and verbal communication skills.
   

 
 

As a plus:
 

Any one of the following can strengthen the profile:
 
 

•  

Machine Safety: Strong knowledge of machine safety principles and how to apply them in an operational environment.
  

•  

Technical Background. A technical secondary school degree, plus ideally experience in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  

•  

Ergonomic Knowledge. Ability to assess ergonomic risks and translate findings into clear, practical improvements.
   

 
 

Other Skills That Step Up Your Performance:
 
 

•  

Facilitation and Reporting Skills. Can facilitate discussions with diverse stakeholders and translate complex information into clear, structured reports.
  

•  

Work Schedule Flexibility. Available to occasionally support outside standard office hours when operational needs require it.

For an international production company specializing in high-quality technologies in Izegem, we are looking for a CNC Machine Loader (day shift).

What will you do?

• Loading and unloading CNC machines: inserting and removing parts based on the production order
• Ensuring an optimal production flow, both for series and single-piece work
• Performing fine deburring work on produced parts
• Carrying out quality controls on machined parts
• Replacing tools and making corrections where necessary
• Contributing to an orderly and tidy workplace with an eye for safety

Who are you?

• Background in metal or CNC
• Good fine motor skills and eye for detail
• Strong mechanical insight and ability to read technical drawings
• Team player with a strong sense of responsibility
• Willing to work in a 2-shift system
• Good knowledge of English

What will you do?

• Clean the interiors of tankers, bulk trucks, container trucks and other vehicles.
• Operate a forklift to move materials and goods.
• Ensure that cleaning orders are carried out correctly.
• Carefully monitor the work during cleaning activities.
• Refill cleaning products in a timely manner.
• Perform general cleaning and maintenance of the workplace.
• Comply with applicable safety and quality regulations.
• Work together with colleagues to complete cleaning assignments efficiently.

Who are you?

• You are characterised by motivation, a willingness to learn and a hands-on mentality.
• Speaking Dutch, English or German is not a problem for you.
• Good physical fitness is important, as this is a physically demanding job; candidates must not suffer from back problems.
• You are comfortable working at heights or in smaller, enclosed spaces.
• Working safely and using the necessary personal protective equipment is second nature to you.
• Experience operating a forklift is required; a forklift certificate is an advantage, but not essential.
• You do not wear glasses, or you are willing to wear contact lenses.
• Basic knowledge of computer programs is an advantage.
• You are able to work both independently and as part of a team.
• Accuracy and a strong sense of responsibility are among your strengths.
• Your own means of transport is essential, as the workplace is not accessible by public transport.
• Experience in industrial cleaning or the cleaning sector is an advantage, but motivation is the priority.

For our client, a niche player within the metal sector, we are looking for a welder on the night shift.

For an international company in the port of Zeebrugge, we're looking for: 100% EV Car Technicians. 

In this role you'll be responsible for troubleshooting, car diagnostics, repairs, quality inspections, software updates, ... 

You have a very good knowledge of English (spoken/written).

You have a technical background in automotive (Level 3 EV certification   working experience).

You are IT literate, with capability to surf through different working tools, reporting systems, diagnostic tool, etc.?

You are communicative as you'll have to update colleagues (technical & non-technical) on the status of the vehicles.

You work organized as you will have to create reports to show results of the performed activities.

As an Administrative & Operations Officer, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth execution of daily operational activities across payments, cash management, trade finance, and client administration.

Client Details

Join a well-established international financial institution with a strong presence across EMEA. Known for its expertise in corporate banking, financial services, and global markets, the company offers a collaborative environment where innovation, operational excellence, and long-term client relationships are at the heart of its success.

Description

• Process and monitor domestic and international payments.
• Manage incoming client requests and internal inquiries via email and phone.
• Support administrative follow-up of banking operations and client files.
• Assist with Trade Finance and Guarantee-related transactions.
• Maintain and update client documentation and e-banking agreements.
• Perform reconciliations, operational controls, and account maintenance tasks.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies and KYC requirements.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives and operational efficiency projects.
• Collaborate with local and international stakeholders.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset (french big plus)
• Strong administrative and organizational skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and eager to learn.
• Strong communication skills and a client-focused mindset.
• Previous experience in administration, operations, banking support, or financial services is a plus.

For a logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for packing employees who can work in a day shift.

You are responsible for the correct handling and shipment of incoming goods.

You will follow a pick list to pack and sort the goods according to their destination.

 
• 
You communicate well in English and/or Dutch.

 
• 
You are available to work from 08:00 to 16:15.

 
• 
Physical work is no issue for you.

 
• 
You stay calm under pressure.

 
• 
You are able to keep a good overview of your tasks.

Are you a technical talent with a passion for innovation? Join a high-tech company at the forefront of the automotive semiconductor industry and help shape the technology of tomorrow.
 

YOUR FUTURE JOB As Technical Lead in the night shift, you will be the team lead of all technical profiles (8 people) in this shift in order to maximize production output while ensuring compliance with defined quality standards. You will coordinate and coach all technical profiles and manages the escalations.
 

More specifically, you will:
 

 
• Ensure that equipment performance meets targets and minimize manufacturing failures.
 
• Support in technical issues on the shop-floor and managing the escalation flow.
 
• Develop and coach technical personnel to reach higher team results.
 
• Be responsible for the administration of the personnel in the shift - holidays, sick leaves, transportation, competency review, etc.
 
• Lead and coordinate escalations with other departments to resolve technical issues promptly.
 
• Distribute the technical tasks among technical personnel in the shift, setting up team priorities, and making follow-ups on the progress during the shift.
 
• Participate in improvement projects.
 
• Support the recruitment of technical personnel if needed.
 
• Support / lead the local certification process (depending if there is a training department on site or not).

 
• Relevant Bachelor degree or Technician with around 5 years of relevant experience.
 
• Good knowledge of technical coaching principles.
 
• Excellent communication, team collaboration and targeted mentoring skills.
 
• Good knowledge of MS office/Google.
 
• Good understanding of English.
 
• Ability to use all necessary job-related tools and make precise manual adjustments.
 
• Analytical, logical, and interpretive mindset for complex technical data.
 
• Proven ability to lead and coordinate technical activities on a shift or zone level.

jobs.description:
For a growing food production company in Oudenaarde, we are looking for a Line Leader Slicing. The company specializes in slicing and packaging ham products for various supermarket chains.

As a Line Leader, you will be responsible for the smooth operation of the slicing line. You will coordinate the production process, support and supervise operators, ensure product quality, and make sure all hygiene and safety standards are respected.

Your Responsibilities

• Leading and supporting employees on the slicing line.
• Setting up, monitoring, and adjusting production machines.
• Ensuring product quality and correct packaging.
• Solving minor machine issues and reporting technical problems.
• Monitoring compliance with hygiene, quality, and safety regulations.
• Following up on production targets and reporting results.

We are looking for Meat Production Workers for a growing food company!

The company processes ham and packages it for various supermarket chains.

The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

Profile

• Previous experience in a production environment is required, preferably within the food industry.
• Experience as a team leader, supervisor, or line leader is an advantage.
• You are detail-oriented and quality-focused.
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.
• You have good communication and leadership skills.
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

We are looking for an enthusiastic CNC miller for our production department. Our client develops and manufactures modular systems for the live communications sector. As a CNC miller, you will mill aluminum profiles according to drawings. You will alternate between batch production and custom work. In addition, you will use an ERP system to process production orders. You will also be responsible for creating milling programs, setting up the milling machine, loading and unloading the machine, and performing quality checks. Furthermore, you will perform first-line maintenance on the machine. 

• Experience as a CNC miller
• Ability to read blueprints and knowledge of using measuring instruments
• Quality-oriented, with a sense of order and neatness
• You are fluent in English
• Willing to work in a two-shift system
• Team player with a positive attitude

We are looking for a Technical Assistant to support the PALL (Product Assessment & Laundry Laboratory) team during a temporary assignment. In this hands-on role, you will perform laundry and wash performance tests, take technical measurements before and after washing cycles, maintain laboratory stock, and ensure accurate data collection and reporting. You will work in a team of three Technical Assistants and receive training on various testing methods and equipment.

In a nutshell you will: 

 
• Perform laundry and wash performance tests according to established procedures. 
 

 
• Take measurements using laboratory equipment (e.g. spectrophotometer). 
 
• Record, verify, and upload test data accurately. 
Maintain testing materials and laboratory stock. 

 
• Communicate with internal stakeholders regarding test requests, observations, and results. 
 
•  
Report any irregularities or unexpected findings during testing.

 
• Available full-time from September 22 through December 23. 
 

 
• Able to work daily from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM. 
 
•  
Accurate, reliable, and detail-oriented. 

 
•  
Comfortable working in a practical, laboratory-based environment. 

 
• Good communication skills in English. 
 

 
• Basic computer skills (Outlook, Excel, and willingness to learn internal systems). 
 

 
• Open to coaching and eager to learn new testing methods. 
 
•  
Able to handle laundry baskets of approximately 3 kg using provided ergonomic equipment.
